user.title: Algo speakers
user.description: All the devices in this group share one REST API password and authentication mode. Leave the password blank for devices whose API authentication is set to None.

data_description.password: The RESTful API password set on each device (Advanced Settings > Admin).
data_description.hosts: IP addresses or hostnames, separated by commas or new lines.
data_description.auth_mode: Must match each device's API authentication setting (Advanced Settings > Admin). Basic is only ever sent over https.

reauth_confirm.title: Algo REST API password
reauth_confirm.description: The devices refused the stored REST API password. Enter the current one.

reconfigure.description: Change the shared REST API password or the device addresses.

firmware_read_only.title: Algo device at {host} is read-only
firmware_read_only.description: The device at {host} runs firmware too old for control (it has no /api/info/about and refuses settings writes). Its volumes and multicast mode are shown as sensors only. Update its firmware to 5.x to control it.

play_tone.name: Play tone
play_tone.description: Plays a tone file stored on the device.

device_id.name: Devices
device_id.description: The Algo devices to play on.

file.name: File
file.description: Tone file name on the device, for example chime.wav.

volume_db.name: Volume
volume_db.description: Sets the ring volume (used for local tones) first, 0 to -45 dB in 3 dB steps.

stop_tone.name: Stop tone
stop_tone.description: Stops the tone playing on the device.

strobe_start.name: Start strobe
strobe_start.description: Starts the strobe on devices that have one (8128, 8138, 8190S, 8410, 8420).

color2.name: Second color
color2.description: Second color; defaults to the first.

play_stream.name: Play stream
play_stream.description: Plays an internet radio stream on an 8301 and multicasts it to the music zone (7).

stop_stream.name: Stop stream
stop_stream.description: Stops the 8301's internet radio by clearing its stream address.

not_algo_device.message: {device} is not a loaded Algo device.

read_only.message: {device} runs firmware too old for control.

not_8301.message: {device} is not an 8301; only the 8301 streams internet radio.

invalid_url.message: The stream address must start with http:// or https://.
